voices.text: This is our vehicle tuning playground: a selectable world for the Safari, original buggy, and Baja four twenty-seven.
Cross-axle ruts and repeated bumps reveal wheel travel, grip, and body movement. The wheels, suspension, and chassis now react together.
Steep grades still expose traction limits. The ridge and side slope test balance and braking, helping us find what to tune next.
Two Excitebike-inspired jumps reveal takeoff attitude, suspension droop, and landing compression. All three vehicles clear the jumps using the same coupled physics.
Steady crosswinds and repeatable gusts change forces and tire loads. The gantry supports aerodynamic tuning, using estimated coefficients rather than measured airflow.
Future games can include this same testing world. Seventy-nine physics checks and six regression tests pass. The next step is your hands-on feedback.
